## Dev8 final source review and concrete local consolidation proposal — 2026-11-05

The focused D50 source/contract review is complete. No blocker is identified for the approved completed-generation save/load/profile factory contract. Existing qualified package/test/wheel bytes are unchanged; the 52 source, 52 exact installed-wheel and five actual SDK controls are reused with their original receipt rather than rerun.

**R1 — corrected documentation inconsistency.** The current standalone product page still described dev6 and gaps already closed by dev7/dev8 (metadata and independent result I/O). The refreshed map now separates exact dev8 source/artifact/SDK evidence, completed work and remaining limits. The full original dev6 page is preserved byte for byte in `devguide/pytorch_product_status_dev6_20261105.md`; guide navigation points to the new current map.

**R2 — confirmed API follow-up, documented and still open.** Direct `GenerationResult(...)` construction and `dataclasses.replace` do not enforce the save/load factories' validated immutable snapshots. The frozen dataclass can retain caller-mutable arrays and arbitrary manifest/digest strings. A bounded model-free diagnostic against the exact installed dev8 wheel confirms that mutating the original caller array changes the manually constructed object's array. This does not exercise or invalidate a saved archive or a validated factory output.

The product guide now states that retained results should use `save_generation_result` / `load_generation_result`. Keep this explicit follow-up in this existing product issue: **clarify or enforce the public constructor contract before API stabilization**. This report does not adopt a redesign. No runtime source is changed solely to obtain another passing result.

The sole new diagnostic exits 0 in 1.54 s, maximum aggregate RSS 62,324,736 bytes (about 59 MiB). CPU0/1, one numerical thread, 30 s wall /10 s CPU, 512 MiB aggregate RSS stop, 4 GiB host reserve, 8 GiB virtual ceiling. Torch/model/SDK imports, network/child dispatch and array/model payload reads are forbidden. Zero neural, learned/PCA or real descriptor calls. Its native success confirms the observation; it is not an additional scientific or pytest qualification.

**Concrete next action prepared:** one local commit on `peptidemt-generation-results`, parent `a77baff9de97e8ab4ae101b9b0c79122dea22ce3`, exactly 21 owned paths. Proposed subject: `Add independent generation results and provenance profile`. Expected tree `cc2c11506e0df4a6238c774e85a12ce0ce82fc52` is computed without writing the Git index/objects; it is a proposed content identity, not an existing commit or public source coordinate. D50 explicitly excludes commit/push, so separate authorization is pending. No push, merge, tag, release, scientific acceptance or external contact is included.

Consumer-maintained local report: `devguide/hydramp_dev8_source_review.md`. Receipt: `devguide/evidence/hydramp_dev8_source_review.json`, SHA-256 `e4fa762a0c67b6ce215692f72081c4e07abf3afeec770d20538bf03512d7126d`. Existing qualification receipt remains unchanged at `fffab901acd64b4c144a67a03b7e45c883d718014ed8cf8a786559e0fd7f748d`. Documentation check: 254 local file links, no missing targets/trailing whitespace; report index and scoped diff-whitespace checks pass. These are documentation checks, not CI/scientific qualification.

Broader #4 / #2 / uibcdf/peptidemt#32 questions remain open. Existing environments/resources and concurrent work are preserved. Retention owner #4/#2/#32; review 2026-11-19.
